Happy to share that I was part of the editing team working on the promos for #LBW streaming on JioHotstar. It was a great experience collaborating with a talented team and contributing to the creative process behind bringing these promos to life. Grateful for the opportunity and excited to see the show reach audiences everywhere. Moments like these remind me why I love storytelling and the craft of editing. Looking forward to many more projects ahead.

#LBW #JioHotstar #EditingTeam #VideoEditing #PromoEdit #PostProduction #ContentCreation #EditorLife #FilmEditing #BehindTheScenes #CreativeWork #Grateful #NewBeginnings 🎬✨

#brothersandsisters Promo :)

Nothing beats the feeling of watching an edit finally come alive.

Had the opportunity to have been part of the main promo for #brothersandsisters for @jiohotstartamil , and this project pushed me creatively in the best way possible. From shaping the energy of the visuals to building the pacing and emotion of the promo, this was one of those edits that reminded me why I love doing this.

A lot of late nights, timeline chaos, constant revisions, and tiny details that nobody notices individually… but together create the final feeling on screen.

Grateful for every opportunity that lets me grow as an editor and storyteller. Really excited for everyone to finally watch this come alive.

More work. More stories. More cinema. 🚀

Modha Rathri (2026) is a Tamil comedy-drama directed by debutant Raja Karuppasamy and produced by Mythri Movie Makers, featuring a tight, single-night plot where two strangers, Maruthanayagam (Rishikanth) and Muthuselvi (Anishma Anilkumar), are thrust into an arranged marriage that descends into chaotic misunderstandings and comedic mysteries on their wedding night. Supported by a stellar ensemble cast including Chetan, Bagavathi Perumal, and Shelly Kishore, the film's tense yet humorous narrative is driven by Surendran Paranjothi's dynamic cinematography, Ashok Arjunan's sharp editing, and an engaging, situational musical score composed by Bharath Sankar.
.

*Obsession* is a supernatural psychological horror film written and directed by Curry Barker. The story follows Bear, a lonely young man who uses a mysterious wish-granting object to make his childhood friend Nikki fall in love with him. What begins as a desperate search for love soon spirals into a terrifying nightmare as Nikki's affection becomes dangerously obsessive. Blending horror with themes of love, obsession, consent, and the consequences of selfish desires, the film delivers an unsettling and emotional experience with unexpected twists and psychological tension throughout.
